* **Orlando-Area Airport Note:**
  Public scheduled commercial flights from the Washington area (DCA, IAD, BWI) operate exclusively into **Orlando International Airport (MCO)**. Secondary regional airports such as Orlando Sanford (SFB) have no nonstop commercial service from DCA, IAD, or BWI on these dates.

1. **Frontier ($38–$117 base teaser fares from IAD/BWI):** Strictly includes only a small personal item (backpack). Carry-on bags in overhead bins cost **$55–$65+ each way per bag** ($165–$195 additional for 3 adults). Standard seat assignments cost **$15–$30 per seat** to sit together ($45–$90 extra). Adding basic baggage/seats wipes out any apparent savings, making Frontier's true practical cost **$330–$480+**.
2. **United Basic Economy ($73–$93 base fares from IAD):** Strictly **prohibits overhead carry-on bags** (personal item only). Bringing a carry-on requires upgrading to regular Economy (+$35–$40/pax) or paying checked-bag fees ($40/bag), pushing the true 3-person practical cost to **$325–$340+**.
3. **Southwest Airlines ($73–$119 base fares):** Every passenger receives **1 personal item + 1 carry-on bag + 2 free checked bags** (up to 6 free checked bags for 3 adults).
